items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Alphonse Piku ever played? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh no, you see, those boys didn't go in for that type of...

ctx.x: Louie Teo. Well, his brother was Lorenzo. Lorenzo was one of them. I don't remember the others.
Do you remember Alphonse Piku ever played? Who? Alphonse Piku.

Oh no, you see, those boys didn't go in for that type of... They had enough training on their instrument, but they didn't go in for that classical side. From the very beginning, they went into the dance field.
